nodes.label: Remixt Brand Mark (split waveform bars)
nodes.description: Seven columns of 12 pill-shaped rounded bars (36px wide, rx=18) on a 512x512 grid forming an audio waveform; the first two columns are whole bars, columns 3-7 are split horizontally into an upper and lower half (pink above, cyan below in color variants), evoking a track being separated into stems / remixed.
nodes.rationale: Waveform-split motif visually communicates the product's purpose: splitting and remixing music audio.

nodes.label: Remixt Pink-Violet-Cyan Gradient Palette
nodes.description: Shared defs in every variant: 'tile' diagonal gradient #ec4899 (pink) -> #8b5cf6 (violet, 55%) -> #06b6d4 (cyan); 'whole' vertical gradient #ec4899 -> #06b6d4. Neutral ink #0a0a0f, light text #f2f2f7.

nodes.label: Remixt Mark (primary app icon)
nodes.variant: Primary: rounded-square tile (rx=116) filled with the pink-violet-cyan diagonal gradient, white bars
